# polaris_grant (Resource)

Manages a securable privilege grant (catalog, namespace, table, or view) to an Apache Polaris catalog role.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "polaris_grant" "admin_all_access" {
  catalog_name      = polaris_catalog.analytics.name
  catalog_role_name = polaris_catalog_role.catalog_admin.name
  type              = "catalog"
  privilege         = "CATALOG_MANAGE_ACCESS"
}

resource "polaris_grant" "read_table_data" {
  catalog_name      = polaris_catalog.analytics.name
  catalog_role_name = polaris_catalog_role.catalog_admin.name
  type              = "table"
  namespace         = ["warehouse"]
  table_name        = "events"
  privilege         = "TABLE_READ_DATA"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `catalog_name` (String) The catalog containing the role and securable resource.
- `catalog_role_name` (String) The catalog role receiving the grant.
- `privilege` (String) The privilege to grant (e.g. `CATALOG_MANAGE_ACCESS`, `TABLE_READ_DATA`, `TABLE_WRITE_DATA`, `NAMESPACE_CREATE`).
- `type` (String) The securable type: `catalog`, `namespace`, `table`, or `view`.

### Optional

- `namespace` (List of String) Namespace hierarchy for namespace, table, or view grants (e.g. `["db1"]` or `["db1", "schema2"]`).
- `table_name` (String) Table name for table grants.
- `view_name` (String) View name for view grants.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The unique identifier of the grant.
